categories.main_business_segments: Halows Co., Ltd. operates a single business segment focused on the retail of food products through a chain of 24-hour supermarkets. The company manages 107 stores primarily in the Setouchi coastal region, including Hiroshima, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima, Hyogo, and Yamaguchi prefectures. Its stores offer a wide range of products such as fresh produce, seafood, prepared foods, meat, daily foods, general groceries, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, and miscellaneous goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes standardized store formats (600 and 450 tsubo models), a 24-hour total operation system, and integrated management of manufacturing, logistics, and sales. It utilizes advanced information systems (EOS, POS), a 24-hour logistics network, and category management for efficient inventory and supply chain operations. Halows also develops private brand (PB) products under the 'Halows Selection' brand, focusing on safety, quality, and affordability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Halows primarily serves individual consumers in suburban and urban residential areas, targeting communities with populations of around 30,000. Its main customer base consists of local households seeking fresh, affordable, and convenient food shopping, with a focus on daily and prepared foods. The company does not rely on any single major customer, as no client accounts for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Japan, with a dominant presence in the Setouchi region, specifically in Hiroshima, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima, Hyogo, and Yamaguchi prefectures. All stores and logistics centers are located within these regions, and there are no overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Halows operates at the downstream end of the supply chain as a retailer, directly selling products to end consumers. It manages its own logistics centers and has some upstream integration through PB product development and procurement, but its primary role is as a food supermarket operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on expanding its store network through dominant regional expansion, enhancing operational efficiency, and evolving its business model to maintain competitiveness. Key initiatives include store standardization, logistics optimization, private brand development, sustainability (CO2 reduction, food waste reduction), and workforce development. R&D activities are limited and mainly relate to product development for PB items and operational improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Halows generates revenue primarily through direct sales of food and daily goods to consumers at its supermarkets. Additional revenue streams include rental income from tenants in shopping centers and other minor service-related income. The company also operates a membership card system (Haroka) with a point-based loyalty program.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Halows competes with other regional and national supermarket chains, as well as discount stores and general merchandise retailers. Its market share in its core regions ranges from 1.2% to 7.8%, with a total regional share of 3.6%. The company positions itself as a dominant, low-cost, 24-hour supermarket chain with a focus on convenience and community integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, Halows reported operating revenue of 210.8 billion yen, operating profit of 12.3 billion yen, and net profit of 8.9 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by 7.8% year-on-year and a five-year CAGR in operating revenue of approximately 10%. It maintains a strong financial position with an equity ratio of 62.2% and aims for continued expansion toward 140 stores and 280 billion yen in revenue by 2030.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Halows differentiates itself through 24-hour operations, standardized large-format stores, a wide assortment of fresh and prepared foods, and a focus on low prices and convenience. The company emphasizes safety, quality, and affordability, supported by integrated logistics and private brand development. Its dominant regional strategy and commitment to community needs, sustainability, and customer service further enhance its competitive edge.
